text:
Qarshi shahar 1-son ixtisoslashtirilgan maktab-internatining 10-T sinf o‘quvchilari uchun unutilmas ilmiy-ma’rifiy sayohat tashkil etildi. 

O‘quvchilar yurtimizning tarixiy va ma’naviy maskanlaridan biri — buyuk vatandoshimiz, islom olamining taniqli allomasi Abu Muin Nasafiy majmuasiga tashrif buyurdilar.

Tashrif davomida yoshlar ulug‘ allomaning hayot yo‘li, boy ilmiy merosi hamda islom tafakkuri va kalom ilmi taraqqiyotiga qo‘shgan beqiyos hissasi haqida qimmatli ma’lumotlarga ega bo‘ldilar. 

Shuningdek, majmuadagi tarixiy obidalar, qadimiy me’moriy san’ati namunalari bilan yaqindan tanishdilar.

Mazkur sayohat o‘quvchilarga nafaqat tarixiy bilimlarini boyitish, balki buyuk ajdodlarimizning ilm-fan va ma’rifat rivojiga qo‘shgan hissasini chuqurroq anglash imkonini berdi.

Zero, o‘z tarixini bilgan, ajdodlari merosini qadrlagan yosh avlodgina milliy g‘urur va yuksak ma’naviyat ruhida kamol topadi!
text_en:
An unforgettable scientific and educational trip was organized for the 10th grade students of Karshi city specialized boarding school No. 1. 

The students visited one of the historical and spiritual places of our country - the complex of our great compatriot, the famous scholar of the Islamic world, Abu Muin Nasafi.

During the visit, the young people got valuable information about the great scholar's life path, rich scientific heritage, and his incomparable contribution to the development of Islamic thought and the science of the word. 

They also got to know the historical monuments and examples of ancient architectural art in the complex.

This trip allowed students not only to enrich their historical knowledge, but also to gain a deeper understanding of the contribution of our great ancestors to the development of science and enlightenment.

After all, only the young generation, which knows its history and appreciates the heritage of its ancestors, matures in the spirit of national pride and high spirituality!

YANGI MUHIT — YANGI TARBIYA — YANGI IMKONIYAT!

✔️Qarshi shahar 1-son ixtisoslashtirilgan maktab-internatida Prezident, ijod va ixtisoslashtirilgan maktab-internatlari tarbiyachi-pedagoglari ishtirokida “Yangi avlod maktab-internati: yangi muhit — yangi tarbiya — yangi imkoniyat” mavzusida hududiy seminar-trening bo‘lib o‘tdi.

🟡Seminarning asosiy maqsadi — maktab-internatlarda tarbiyaviy ishlar samaradorligini oshirish, ilg‘or pedagogik tajribalarni ommalashtirish, tarbiyachi-pedagoglarning kasbiy mahoratini yuksaltirish hamda ta’lim-tarbiya jarayoniga zamonaviy yondashuvlarni keng tatbiq etishdan iborat.

📊Seminar davomida ishtirokchilar o‘zaro tajriba almashib, ilg‘or ish uslublari, innovatsion metodlar va samarali tarbiyaviy yondashuvlar bilan yaqindan tanishdilar. Shuningdek, ta’lim-tarbiya jarayonini yanada takomillashtirishga qaratilgan fikr va takliflar bildirildi.
Mazkur seminar-trening pedagogik hamkorlikni mustahkamlash, yangi tashabbuslarni qo‘llab-quvvatlash va tarbiyaviy faoliyatda yangi imkoniyatlar yaratish yo‘lidagi muhim qadam bo‘ldi.

♾Zero, yangi avlod tarbiyasi — yangi yondashuv, mustahkam hamkorlik va yuksak mas’uliyatni talab etadi!
text_en:
NEW ENVIRONMENT — NEW EDUCATION — NEW OPPORTUNITY!

✔️A regional seminar-training on the topic "New generation boarding school: new environment - new education - new opportunity" was held in Karshi city specialized boarding school No. 1 with the participation of the President, creative and specialized boarding school educators.

🟡The main goal of the seminar is to increase the effectiveness of educational work in boarding schools, to popularize advanced pedagogical experiences, to improve the professional skills of educators, and to widely apply modern approaches to the educational process.

📊During the seminar, the participants exchanged experiences and got acquainted with advanced working methods, innovative methods and effective educational approaches. Also, opinions and suggestions aimed at further improvement of the educational process were expressed.
This seminar-training was an important step towards strengthening pedagogical cooperation, supporting new initiatives and creating new opportunities in educational activities.

♾ Because the education of the new generation requires a new approach, strong cooperation and high responsibility!

text:
♾DIQQAT, E’LON! KELAJAK MUHANDISLARI UCHUN KATTA IMKONIYAT! 
Qarshi shahar 1-son ixtisoslashtirilgan maktab-internatida o‘quvchilarning texnik salohiyati va muhandislik tafakkurini kashf etish maqsadida “YOSH ENERGETIKLAR — KELAJAK MUHANDISLARI” musobaqasiga start berilmoqda!

Agar sizda yangi texnik g‘oyalar, aqlli qurilmalar yoki energiya tejamkor loyihalar bo‘lsa, o‘z bilimingizni amalda ko‘rsatish vaqti keldi!

 💠Musobaqaning maqsadi: O‘quvchilarning muhandislik tafakkurini rivojlantirish, innovatsion g‘oyalarini qo‘llab-quvvatlash hamda zamonaviy va energiya tejamkor texnologiyalarga bo‘lgan qiziqishini oshirish.
🧑‍⚕️ Kimlar qatnasha oladi? 5–11-sinf o‘quvchilari (2–4 nafardan iborat jamoalar shaklida).

📊 Musobaqa yo‘nalishlari:
Robototexnika va avtomatlashtirish: Aqlli robotlar, sensorli va avtomatlashtirilgan qurilmalar.
Qayta tiklanuvchi energiya manbalari: Quyosh panellari, shamol generatorlari va muqobil energiya yechimlari.
Energiya tejamkor aqlli maktab va aqlli uy: Energiyani tejashga xizmat qiluvchi zamonaviy maketlar.

♾ Musobaqa shartlari:
Har bir jamoa o‘z tayyorlagan loyihasi yoki qurilmasini hakamlar hay’atiga taqdim etadi;
Loyihaning ishlash prinsipi va amaliy ahamiyati asoslab beriladi;
Loyihalar maxsus 100 ballik baholash tizimi asosida (qurilmaning ishlashi, energiya samaradorligi, muhandislik yondashuvi, yangilik, amaliy sinov natijalari va elektr xavfsizligi kabi 10 ta mezon bo‘yicha) xolisona baholanadi.

🔔 G‘oliblarni nima kutmoqda?
I, II va III darajali diplomlar;
Eng kreativ va istiqbolli loyihalar uchun maxsus nominatsiyalar bo‘yicha rag‘batlantirish!
‼️ Unutmang: bugungi kichik g‘oya — ertangi katta kashfiyot!
Jamoangizni tuzing, loyihangizni tayyorlang va KELAJAK MUHANDISLARI SAFIGA QO‘SHILING!
text_en:
♾ ATTENTION, ANNOUNCEMENT! GREAT OPPORTUNITY FOR FUTURE ENGINEERS! 
In order to discover the technical potential and engineering thinking of students, the competition "YOUNG ENERGETICS - FUTURE ENGINEERS" is being launched at the specialized boarding school No. 1 of Karshi city!

If you have new tech ideas, smart devices, or energy-efficient projects, it's time to put your knowledge into practice!

 💠The purpose of the competition: to develop students' engineering thinking, support their innovative ideas and increase their interest in modern and energy-efficient technologies.
🧑‍⚕️ Who can participate? 5-11th grade students (in teams of 2-4 people).

📊 Competition directions:
Robotics and Automation: Intelligent robots, sensors and automated devices.
Renewable energy sources: Solar panels, wind generators and alternative energy solutions.
Energy-efficient smart school and smart home: Modern layouts to save energy.

♾ Competition conditions:
Each team presents its prepared project or device to the jury;
The working principle and practical importance of the project are justified;
Projects are objectively evaluated based on a special 100-point evaluation system (on 10 criteria, such as device performance, energy efficiency, engineering approach, innovation, practical test results, and electrical safety).

🔔 What awaits the winners?
I, II and III degree diplomas;
Promotion of special nominations for the most creative and promising projects!
‼️ Don't forget: today's small idea is tomorrow's big discovery!
Build your team, prepare your project and JOIN THE ENGINEERS OF THE FUTURE!

VICTORY AT THE INTERNATIONAL OLYMPICS — HIGH RECOGNITION AND APPROPRIATE ENCOURAGEMENT

In the 2025-2026 academic year, the students of Kashkadarya region, who took part in the International Science Olympiad, won a total of 1 gold, 4 silver and 4 bronze medals. 

Happily, 7 of these achievements belong to the students of Karshi city specialized boarding school No. 1.

The high results of our students in the international field, as well as the selfless work of the teachers who gave them knowledge and skills, were duly recognized and encouraged with the following monetary awards:
🏆 Tokhtamurodov Elbek - school teacher - 30,800,000 soums.

🏆 Kholmurodov Jasur - school teacher - 22,000,000 soums.
🏅 Son of Ziyodullayev Dilbek Bekzod - 8th grade student - 5,320,000 soums.
🏆 Markayeva Dilfuza - school teacher - 15,400,000 soums.
🏅 Shahabiddinova, daughter of Imrona Dilshad - 9th grade student - 3,520,000 soums.

In this way, 4 students and 4 teachers of our school received monetary awards in the amount of 121 million 480 thousand soums.
Such high recognition and incentives are of great importance in increasing the interest of young people in science, encouraging them to new heights, as well as raising an educated, talented and potential generation who can adequately defend the honor of our Motherland in the international arena.

In addition, in the TOP-10 ranking of educational institutions that have won the most medals at international science Olympiads, Karshi city specialized boarding school No. 1 took the proud 7th place in the country.

The achieved achievements are a bright example of research, tireless work and dedication of teachers!

We sincerely congratulate all our winning students and their teachers with this high recognition! We wish you great success in your future scientific and creative activities!
